title: Forward-Free Diffusion Language Models with BPTT-Free Looped Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2606.08357v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising, offering a powerful alternative to autoregressive generation. However, discrete language spaces lack a natural neighborhood structure for defining effective perturbations, motivating artificial corruption schemes in the forward process. Such prescribed forward processes often produce states that are mathematically convenient but misaligned with the drafts and errors encountered during generation, resulting in degraded sample quality. To address this limitation, we propose FReDA, a forward-free diffusion language model that eliminates the need for a hand-designed forward process. We formulate diffusion language modeling as recursive distribution refinement, in which model-generated drafts serve as implicit intermediate states and the learned refinement model progressively moves the draft distribution toward the target distribution. translated_title: 免前向过程的扩散语言模型与无BPTT循环细化
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过迭代去噪生成文本，为自回归生成提供了一种强大的替代方案。然而，离散语言空间缺乏自然的邻域结构来定义有效的扰动，这促使在前向过程中采用人工设计的腐蚀方案。这种预设的前向过程通常产生数学上便利但与生成过程中遇到的草稿和错误不一致的状态，导致样本质量下降。为解决这一限制，我们提出了FReDA，一种免前向过程的扩散语言模型，消除了对手工设计前向过程的需求。我们将扩散语言建模表述为递归分布细化，其中模型生成的草稿作为隐式中间状态，学习的细化模型逐步将草稿分布推向目标分布。训练过程中，前一步的细化被分离（即不进行反向传播）。
tldr: 本文提出FReDA，一种无需人工设计前向过程的扩散语言模型，通过递归分布细化利用模型生成的草稿作为中间状态，避免了传统扩散模型中的前向扰动和BPTT训练开销，提升了生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FReDA, a forward-free diffusion language model that eliminates hand-designed forward processes by using model-generated drafts as implicit intermediate states in recursive distribution refinement, avoiding BPTT training costs and improving sample quality.
